assertions.assertion: Explains that with static key management SAML requires an X.509 signing certificate that includes a private key
assertions.rationale: It states that under static key management, enabling SAML requires an X.509 signing certificate that includes a private key.

assertions.assertion: States that a manually registered raw RSA key, including one from AddDeveloperSigningCredential(), cannot be auto-wrapped into an X.509 certificate for SAML
assertions.rationale: It explains AddDeveloperSigningCredential() registers a raw RSA key that IdentityServer will not auto-wrap into an X.509 certificate for SAML under static management.

assertions.assertion: Notes that OIDC tokens and SAML messages share the same signing credentials and rotation schedule, published via the OIDC JWKS endpoint and SAML IdP metadata
assertions.rationale: It explicitly states OIDC and SAML share the same signing credentials and rotation schedule, published in parallel via JWKS and SAML IdP metadata.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that PropagationTime and RetentionDuration control how long keys/certs are published before signing and retained for validation during rollover
assertions.rationale: It describes PropagationTime as publish-before-signing time for SPs to refresh metadata and RetentionDuration as keeping the previous certificate for validation during overlap.

assertions.assertion: Notes that under Automatic Key Management the SAML component auto-wraps managed RSA keys in self-signed X.509 certificates, so UseX509Certificate is not required just to enable SAML
assertions.rationale: The contrast note states that under Automatic Key Management the SAML component auto-wraps managed RSA keys into self-signed X.509 certificates and UseX509Certificate is not required just to enable SAML.
